requirements.reason: Repository governance, register, checklist, and non-closure review are the current proof; provider-dashboard access facts require later external evidence.

Repository secret lifecycle, classification, and credential-safety review are the current proof; managed secret storage, deployed injection, rotation, revocation, and owner proof require later external evidence.
Repository source and configuration boundary review are the current proof; frontend bundle, deployment, and runtime binding proof require later external evidence.
Evidence handling standards, checklist, metadata, staleness, open-gap, and repository-safety review are the current proof; sanitized provider evidence packages require later external evidence.
Canonical-plan and final scope review protect against false closure; provider and runtime proof require later external evidence.
